about: Licence texts a pinned tree needs but does not carry: copies of an upstream file (repository, commit, path) or, where no upstream text exists, a notice written from the component's own metadata (derived_from). build/notices-assemble.sh collects them; tools/tests/test_notices_extra.py checks the bytes.

D3D12TranslationLayer-LICENSE.for: DXMT's libs/DXBCParser: its files say 'Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. Licensed under the MIT License' and come from microsoft/D3D12TranslationLayer (BlobContainer, DXBCUtils, ShaderBinary) and microsoft/DirectX-Headers (d3d12tokenizedprogramformat.hpp), whose LICENSE texts are identical

MoltenVK-LICENSE.for: MoltenVK inside GStreamer's iOS release (libGStreamer.a carries libMoltenVK's master object; Vulkan SDK 1.3.283.0 ships MoltenVK v1.2.9); Apache-2.0, notice only (decision 0042)

ns-keyed-archive-NOTICE-from-metadata.for: the ns-keyed-archive 0.1.5 crate, which has no licence file anywhere (docs/release-audits/stikjit-rust.md, 2026-09-30); owner's decision 0039
ns-keyed-archive-NOTICE-from-metadata.derived_from: the crate's Cargo.toml license and authors fields
